question.text: A single string runs over a pulley that is fixed to a ceiling. On one side, the string carries a 2 kg block, and a second string hangs a 1 kg block below that 2 kg block; call the tension in this lower string T₃. On the other side, the string carries a 3 kg block, and a second string hangs a 4 kg block below that 3 kg block; call the tension in this lower string T₁. Call the tension in the main string over the pulley T₂. Taking g = 10 m/s², work out the system's acceleration and the tension values T₁, T₂ and T₃.
conditions: pulley is fixed to the ceiling
left side: 2 kg block above, 1 kg block below, joined by string T₃
right side: 3 kg block above, 4 kg block below, joined by string T₁
main string over the pulley has tension T₂

figure.description: A pulley is fixed to a ceiling. A single string passes over this pulley. On the left, this string is tied to a 2 kg block; a second string, T₃, hangs from the 2 kg block down to a 1 kg block below it. On the right, the string is tied to a 3 kg block; a second string, T₁, hangs from the 3 kg block down to a 4 kg block below it. The tension in the main string over the pulley, on either side, is called T₂.

solution.approach: Find the common acceleration from the total mass on each side of the pulley, then isolate each block in turn to find its own tension.

steps.text: Add the mass on each side of the fixed pulley.
The heavier right side descends; find the common acceleration from the whole system.
Find T₂, the main string tension, from the left side (2 kg + 1 kg) moving upward.
Find T₃, the tension between the 2 kg and 1 kg blocks, from the 1 kg block alone.
Find T₁, the tension between the 3 kg and 4 kg blocks, from the 4 kg block alone.

final_answer.value: a = 4 m/s²; T₁ = 24 N; T₂ = 42 N; T₃ = 14 N

common_mistakes.text: Using only the two blocks nearest the pulley (2 kg and 3 kg) for the acceleration instead of the full 3 kg and 7 kg sides, giving a = 2 m/s².
Finding T₃ as T₂ minus the 2 kg block's weight, forgetting its acceleration term, giving T₃ = 42−20 = 22 N instead of 14 N.
